test_experiment_add_job: test the Experiment.add method to launch a single job with args and name
test_experiment_add_job_group: test the Experiment.add method to launch a JobGroup containing multiple named jobs
test_experiment_add_job_generator: test the Experiment.add method with an async job generator function that receives work_unit and custom args
test_contextvars_experiment_tracking: test contextvars _current_experiment and _current_experiment_unit track active experiment and work unit across sync and async contexts
test_get_xid_from_context: test the get_xid_from_context function returns experiment id from contextvars, global variable, or -1 fallback
